name: Screenshot and screen recording detection
plain: Apps are told when the person takes a screenshot or records the screen.
meaning: Lets a chat, bank or media app react to capture. Reveals the person kept a copy. Android 14 added screenshot detection; iOS has had it since iOS 7.

android.note: Screenshot detection since 14; recording detection since 15

ios.api_surface: Notified after the screenshot is taken; isCaptured true during recording or mirroring

limits.headline: Can tell when you take a screenshot or record the screen, but not stop you
limits.user_action: You take a screenshot or start a screen recording while the app is open
can: Get told when you take a screenshot, on Android 14 and newer, and iPhone
Get told while the screen is being recorded or mirrored
Show a warning or hide private content during recording
cannot: Stop the screenshot on iPhone; the app learns after it is taken
See the screenshot or recording itself
Detect screen recording on Android 14 or older; it needs Android 15
Detect captures from another device pointed at the screen
limits.differs: Android 14 added screenshot detection and Android 15 added recording detection. iPhone has had both for years.

story.what_it_is: Apps are told when you take a screenshot or record your screen.

marketing.name: Screenshot detection
marketing.pitch: Android 14 feature page: apps can register a callback to learn when the user takes a screenshot.

story.for_you: You take a screenshot of a chat and the other person gets a note, or the app shows a warning. You may not know the app noticed. Some apps also blank the screen during a recording.
story.for_makers: Chat, banking and video apps use it to protect private content and warn senders. Streaming firms use it to guard protected shows. It also tells makers that you kept a copy.

use_cases.example: A chat app tells the sender when you screenshot a disappearing message.
A bank app shows a warning after a screenshot of your balance or card number.
A streaming app blanks protected video if you record the screen.
A game reacts to a screenshot by showing a share prompt to post your score.
A dating app warns a match when someone captures their photo.
A work app logs screenshots of confidential documents for auditing.
A fraud tool treats a screen recording while a bank app is open as a possible scam.

risks: Reveals that you kept a copy
Can be bypassed by a camera
story.android_note: Android 14 added a callback for screenshot detection, with a normal permission.
story.ios_note: iOS has told apps about screenshots since iOS 7 and recording state since iOS 11.
